What the redesign fixes

  • Static, exported HTML served without HTTPS — browsers can flag it “Not Secure”.
  • Legacy /index.htm structure with dated styling.
  • A confusing half-rebrand (His Way vs “Appliance Connection”) muddies trust.
  • No online booking and no clear service-area or brands-serviced info.
